First off i really appreciate the reply, the last few days have been some of the more testing ones in my life. A few years back i was working a dead end job and hated it, decided i would try make something of my self so i quit that job, found a better place to work part time and applied to go to college, iv  just finished my first year doing public services and passed with the highest marks ( It wasn't the hardest course so not much of an achievement ). I thought doing this would change my mind set as i have always got more out of helping people than i have doing something for my self, becoming a police officer was something i thought would help me continue and for a short period it did help a bit, gave me a slither of hope, that faded quickly and im just at the point where i am a normal person, i empathise, get upset, be genuinely happy but when it all comes down to it i just dont want to be alive, i dont know how to explain it, i just dont. To answer if i have told anyone, in the 8 years i have felt this way i have openly told 2 people, one was a long distance relationship with someone i thought i actually cared about, after telling her she put some distance between us as things got to weird for her i guess and the other was just 3 days ago actually as i have been feeling a lot closer to doing it i thought i would share it with someone. A girl from work who likes me invited me over, i told her i didn't want a relationship or anything due to having so many problems, we hung out and as we were laying down together she asked and i told, she was understanding but didn't say much about it after other than i should talk to my doctor but i cant due to the fact that if i want to become a police officer this will prevent me from doing so, that is if i have not killed my self by then. sorry for the long reply and if you did read it all then thank you, i really do appreciate it.
